feed.title: antxiko — commented disassemblies of 8-bit games
feed.subtitle: Old 8-bit binaries taken apart byte by byte and commented, with the tools to rebuild them: nothing gets claimed that the binary does not show, and the source has to give the original back, byte for byte. Right now that means 100 MSX games.

entry.title: Issun-boushi no Donnamondai: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: Issun-boushi to each side on land, with the copy of his drawings turned the other way that the game makes, and on the river in his rocking bowl, every enemy with its two sprites and the character of the end, all built from the cartridge's own tables and code. Checked against openMSX: Issun-boushi identical on 26,364 frames and the bowl on 15,967.

entry.title: Youkai Yashiki: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the hero standing and walking in his two sprites, his weapon to each side, and the drawings and colours the code gives the ghosts, all built from the cartridge's own tables. Checked against openMSX: the hero identical on 26,999 frames and the weapon on 13,221, 0 different.

entry.title: The Seal of Hades: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the hero in his four sprites with the colours of each power, his shots, every kind of enemy with its two sprites and its drawings, and the big and small explosions, all built from the cartridge's own tables and code. Checked against openMSX: the hero identical on 41,128 frames and the enemies on 90,076.

entry.title: The Stone of Wisdom: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the hero to the four sides with his steps, his weapon in each direction, every kind of enemy, the stone, the sage in three sprites and the explosion, all built from the cartridge's own tables and code. Checked against openMSX: the enemies identical on 73,362 frames, the weapon on 5,818 and the hero on 29,434.

entry.title: Moai no Hihou: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the hero standing, walking, jumping, punching, waiting and dying, each from its own table, and the ten kinds of things on the map with the drawings they change through, all built from the cartridge's own tables and code. Checked against openMSX: the things identical on 21,879 frames and the hero on 57,403.

entry.title: Koneko no Daibouken: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the kitten facing each way, hit, jumping, crouching and carrying something on its head, and every creature by its type, with the drawing table built for each scene, where the same number is a different creature, all from the cartridge's own tables and code. Checked against openMSX: the creatures identical on 150,573 frames and the kitten on 61,070.

entry.title: Iga Ninpouchou: Mangetsu-jou: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the ninja facing each side, jumping, falling, crouching and hit, the enemy ninja of every type and stage, the stars, arrows and things that fall, and the five-sprite boss in the colours of each round, all built from the cartridge's own tables and code. Checked against openMSX: the ninja identical on 76,679 frames and the enemy ninja on 60,362.

entry.title: Exoide-Z Area 5: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the ship and its hit, every kind of enemy with the drawings it turns through and the colour that blinks, the big ship of the end, the bullets and the explosion, all built from the cartridge's own tables and code. Checked against openMSX: the ship identical on 55,725 frames and the enemies on 63,347.

entry.title: Eagle Fighter: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the plane on the runway, in the air with the controller in its eight directions and crashed, the enemies of every type with their drawings to each side, the big one, the shots and the explosions, all built from the cartridge's own tables and code. Checked against openMSX: the enemies identical on 8,018 frames and the plane on 12,642.

entry.title: Shindobaddo: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: Sindbad walking, striking with his scimitar, on the ladders, bouncing, falling and dead, the giant bird with its two wing drawings and the enemies, which are tiles, all drawn by running the game's own routines. Checked against openMSX: Sindbad identical on 17,021 frames and the enemies' tiles on 22,205, 0 different.

entry.title: Exoide-Z: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the ship and its shadow, the robot it turns into and its punches, the explosions, the five enemies in their four colours, the capsules and the big robot of each round, all built from the cartridge, whose own routines are run here to make the drawings with their mirror copies. Checked against openMSX: the enemies identical on 45,717 frames and the ship on 22,246, 0 different.

entry.title: Iga Ninpouchou: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the ninja walking, jumping, crouching and hit, almost invisible with the object, and his star; the ninja on the floors, who get two colours from a single sprite by showing body and details in turns; the arrow, the balls, the stars and what falls, all built from the cartridge's own tables and code. Checked against openMSX: the ninja identical on 19,464 frames, 0 different. And a fix: type 8 throws balls, not arrows; the arrow is type 1.

entry.title: Ice World: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the hero in his four directions with the hammer, hitting and losing, the thrown hammer and the points, and the two creatures, which are not sprites but pieces of tiles, walking, crushed and hatching, all built from the cartridge's own tables and code. Checked against openMSX: the hero identical on 48,058 frames and the creatures on 35,621, 0 different.

entry.title: Car Fighter: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the car in its four directions, the other cars and the truck, hit twice and blowing up, the bomb, the shot and the loose things, and the blast frame by frame, all built from the cartridge's own tables and code. Checked against openMSX: the drawing table identical on 49,805 frames, the cars on 41,057 and the trucks on 1,786.

entry.title: Pachinko U.F.O.: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the launcher, the windmills, the ball and the U.F.O.s in their steps and colours, and the U.F.O.s frame by frame, all built from the cartridge's own tables. Checked against openMSX: the drawing table identical on 43,152 frames and the whole sprite table on 15,263.

entry.title: Exciting Jockey: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the horse's ten drawings in the four colours, its four animations (gallop, jump, fall and on the ground) at the pace the code walks them, and the jockey, all built from the cartridge's own tables. Checked against openMSX: the drawing table identical on 44,335 frames and the horses on 62,625.

entry.title: Exciting Baseball: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: every sprite drawing, with the left-hander's flipped on the fly, and the batter through his swing frame by frame, all built from the cartridge's own tables. Checked against openMSX: the drawing table identical on 11,922 frames and the batter on 5,989 with 0 different.

entry.title: Ski Command: the sprites, put together from the ROM
entry.summary: A new page: the skier's eleven drawings, the seven enemies in their four sizes and knocked down, the flying machine in its three colours and hit, and the course objects, all built from the cartridge's own tables; the jump and the crash frame by frame as the code does them. Checked against openMSX: the sprite drawing table identical on 17,989 frames, the skier and the machine with 0 different frames.

entry.title: Five more Casio cartridges, Game Land among them
entry.summary: The Stone of Wisdom, The Seal of Hades, Youkai Yashiki, Issun-boushi no Donnamondai and Game Land, Casio's 1984 kit for making games without programming. Each one 100% explained, reassembled byte for byte and commented to 40% or more; the games played in GIF in openMSX and, in Game Land, a background drawn with its own LINE, BOX, CIRCLE and PAINT and two characters from its samples; the music from each cartridge's own sound engine, checked against openMSX.

entry.title: Fourteen Casio cartridges, taken apart
entry.summary: Fourteen MSX cartridges by Casio, from 1984 to 1986: Ski Command, Exciting Baseball, Exciting Jockey, Pachinko U.F.O., Car Fighter, Ice World, Iga Ninpouchou, Exoide-Z, Shindobaddo Nanatsu no Bouken, Eagle Fighter, Exoide-Z Area 5, Iga Ninpouchou Mangetsu-jou no Tatakai, Koneko no Daibouken and Moai no Hihou. Each one 100% explained, reassembled byte for byte and commented to 40% or more; the titles from running the ROM, checked against openMSX; the games played in GIF in openMSX; the music from each cartridge's own sound engine, checked against openMSX frame by frame.
